name: What is the typical process for scheduling a window repair service?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for scheduling a window repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins when you contact us to describe the issue. We'll then schedule an inspection to accurately assess the damage and provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, we coordinate a convenient time for the repair, ensuring we have the necessary materials and equipment. For homeowners in areas like Alameda or Berkeley, it's helpful to describe the window type (e.g., single-pane, double-pane, vinyl, wood) when you call, as this can help us prepare more efficiently for the initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule an inspection, get an estimate, approve the work, and we'll arrange the repair. Providing window type details when scheduling helps streamline the process.
